checklist: printf 'abc\n' | rev → cba (bash pipeline); rev FILE; rev keeps UTF-8 characters whole
column -t -s, lines up a CSV (bytes compared); -o ' | ' output separator; whitespace table from stdin
getopt parses long options (--beta=x, --beta x, --alpha) and short ones; eval set -- loop in bash
getopt -T → rc 4 (enhanced getopt); unknown long option → 'unrecognized option', rc 1
colrm 2 3 removes columns; look PREFIX FILE finds sorted matches (look-read-fallback.patch: no mmap on slicc)
rev / column on a missing file → 'No such file or directory', rc 1

users (users enforce, #687): 2.42.4-2 links the slicc credentials (slicc_cred_js); as cone, rev, hexdump -C, look and column on root's 0600 and 0622 files are 'Permission denied', rc 1, no stdout; on root's 0644 and cone's own 0600 they give the contents (compared); root reads all four

cert/flock.mjs (2.42.4-5, homescoop#977): flock -n on a free lock rc 0; while flock -x /tmp/l sleep 4 holds it, flock -n is rc 1, -n -E 9 is rc 9, and -w 1 times out with rc 1 after >= 0.9 s; a blocking flock -s … -c 'echo got it' waits for the holder, then prints 'got it'; afterwards flock -n succeeds, flock … bash -c 'exit 7' is rc 7, and -w 0 on a free lock is rc 0. The cert kernel moves to 1.132.1: 1.102.6 has no flock table (flock -n gets the lock while it's held)

cert/flock.mjs (2.42.4-7, homescoop#1465, #1500): flock -F /tmp/l bash -c 'exit 7' is rc 7 and flock -F /tmp/l -c 'echo f' prints f; while flock -F -x /tmp/l sleep 3 holds the lock, flock -n is rc 1, and it is free once that ends; flock --verbose waiting about 2.5 s on a holder reports getting lock took >= 1.0 seconds

Peter Anvin), getopt.c (Frodo Looijaard), column.c (Karel Zak) and the Regents of the University of California lines of rev.c, colrm.c and look.c

patches.look-read-fallback.patch: look PREFIX FILE (slicc's filesystem has no mmap: ENODEV → read the file whole)
patches.flock-slicc.patch: __EMSCRIPTEN__ only: flock(1) starts its command with posix_spawnp (and posix_spawn_file_actions_addclose for -o) instead of fork + execvp, and -w polls LOCK_NB every 20 ms against a CLOCK_MONOTONIC deadline instead of interrupting a blocking flock() with a setitimer SIGALRM, which a JS timer never delivers (homescoop#977). --verbose times the wait with CLOCK_MONOTONIC, since gettime_monotonic's CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW fails under Emscripten (homescoop#1500). cert/flock.mjs: without it there is no fork, -w never times out, and --verbose reports 0.000000 seconds
